paper_info.title: Efficient Multi-Scale Model
paper_info.problem: Existing models are accurate but too expensive for deployment.

innovations.title: Factorized multi-scale attention
innovations.summary: The model separates spatial and temporal attention while sharing a compact backbone.

innovations.title: Unified task decoder
innovations.summary: A shared decoder handles detection, prediction, and reconstruction outputs.

innovations.title: Annotation-efficient pipeline
innovations.summary: The training pipeline combines sparse depth and semantic labels.

method.overview: Images pass through a shared encoder before factorized spatial and temporal attention.

steps.title: Shared encoder
steps.detail: The encoder converts multi-camera images into shared latent tokens.

steps.title: Spatial fusion
steps.detail: Spatial attention exchanges information across camera views.

steps.title: Temporal fusion
steps.detail: Temporal attention aggregates observations from neighboring frames.

steps.title: Task decoding
steps.detail: Task-specific heads produce geometry, semantics, and reconstruction.

formulas.explanation: Attention combines projected tokens while scaling by the channel dimension.
The objective balances task supervision and geometric consistency.

experiments.setup: Evaluated on two driving datasets against four baselines.

ablations.claim: Spatial fusion improves mIoU by 3.4 points.

summary.value: The method reduces deployment cost while retaining accuracy.
summary.conclusion: A practical architecture for efficient multi-view perception.
